messages.content: What's the mass of an electron?

function.name: calculate_magnetic_field
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field at a certain distance from a straight wire carrying current using Ampere’s Law.

current.description: The current flowing through the wire in amperes. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance from the wire at which to calculate the magnetic field in meters. This is a float type value.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space. The default value is 4π × 10^−7 N/A^2. This is a float type value.

message.content:
The mass of an electron is a fundamental physical constant. Its value is:

**mₑ = 9.10938356 × 10⁻³¹ kilograms** (approximately 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg)

This is the rest mass of the electron, which is one of the smallest and most fundamental particles in nature.
